tasks.short: Develop and present community health education programs

steps.what: Define the community audience, learning needs and intended health message
Read and verify health guidance and culturally suitable examples
Write the workshop, conference or community presentation content

loop.input: Specialist-entered audience and learning purpose, selected guidance passages and allowed examples
loop.output: Draft session outline and explanations with claims linked to guidance
loop.check: Specialist edits in s3 and checks health meaning, limitations, cultural fit and accessibility in s5; unsupported health advice is rejected
loop.stop: One draft and one revision, then manual composition
loop.why_not_simpler: Reuse approved education blocks first; new audience-specific explanations require bounded prose drafting

steps.what: Format actual slides, activity sheets and presentation materials
Check final health meaning, source support and audience accessibility
Present the health program and respond to participants' questions

tasks.design: Test native {DOCS} layouts and existing approved education blocks, then draft new explanations only from the specialist's actual brief and verified sources. Keep complete health-meaning review and live presentation with the specialist; no new participant data collection or automated public message is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Audience-specific writing is mixed with reusable guidance blocks and presentation layout.
tasks.enabler_now: Bounded source-based drafting can help express an already selected health message.
tasks.still_hard: A clear message can still mislead if it loses limitations or does not fit the community.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist notices misunderstanding and adapts discussion to participants' circumstances.
tasks.altitude: Less first-draft prose and repetitive layout; health-message selection and live education stay human.

reach.task: Test whether a health message is understandable

evidence.claim: Source-bound education drafting and native material layouts are plausible components; this health-education implementation and timing are model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary covers actual program content and presentation, not venue booking or promotion campaigns. Actual materials are represented separately from live talk; no attendance or completion log is invented.

The specialist supplies audience, purpose, allowed examples and constraints in s1 and selects verified source passages in s2. Missing evidence is sought manually in those retained steps; no clean health-content feed or participant profile is assumed.

Ten of twenty-five writing hours are initial prose assembly; fifteen remain for original examples and rewriting. Three of ten formatting hours are repeated styles and layout; seven remain for diagrams, access adaptations and repairs. All ten final meaning-check hours remain.

Native templates precede custom code. Ordinary saving remains within document work without a self-gate or saving. Live presentation is not an automated external send; any separately distributed pack must be measured and gated on its final version before extending this design.
research_questions: Does drafting preserve source limitations after full specialist correction?

already_counted.description: Rewrite and check the complete health message

incremental.description: Maintain allowed sources and education layouts

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central gross is ten prose plus three formatting hours less two upkeep = 11. Cautious case: sensitive community messaging requires all twenty-five writing hours manually, while native layout still removes three hours, less two upkeep = 1. Source review and live presentation are unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Agree community needs, available services and goals with partners

steps.what: Read existing community health evidence and partner information
Look up relevant health services and verify current availability
Discuss community needs and service gaps with health specialists and civic groups
Agree realistic goals and responsibilities for meeting the identified needs
Write the agreed goals in the existing community program plan
Save the goals in the same program plan

tasks.design: Configure source-preserving service filters in the existing community service directory {OTHER}. Keep availability confirmation, partner discussion, goal decisions and actual first goal writing in {DOCS} with the specialist.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated service searches can consume preparation time while service capacity remains uncertain.
tasks.enabler_now: Native filters can locate existing directory entries without recommending eligibility or setting goals.
tasks.still_hard: Service capacity and community priorities need direct partner confirmation.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist reconciles competing needs and builds commitments that partners can deliver.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated service searching; partnership and goal-setting rights stay unchanged.

reach.task: Verify whether a local service can meet an expressed need
reach.learn: Service scope, access barriers and current capacity

evidence.claim: A maintained service directory can support source-based lookup while availability and community judgement remain human; the allocation is model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual first writing of agreed goals in the program plan used to develop the intervention; no new meeting-minutes or activity log is added.

Existing service agencies or directory maintainers supply service name, scope, catchment, eligibility description, contact, update date and availability statement. The specialist verifies current capacity manually within s2; missing or stale entries require direct lookup and contact, not a free repaired feed.

Only three of ten service-search hours are repeated searching and filtering; seven remain for relevance, source reading and capacity confirmation. All goal writing and the one-hour ordinary save are fully retained, with no author approval gate.
Test native directory filters before custom code. No external referral, partner promise or automated disclosure is created by this read-only design.
unknowns: Directory currency and current search tools
Time spent confirming capacity versus locating entries
research_questions: Do native directory filters remove repeat search without hiding service limitations?

already_counted.description: Verify source relevance and actual service capacity

incremental.description: Review directory filters and stale-entry handling

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central gross is three repeated-search hours less 0.5 upkeep = 2.5. Cautious case: new services or stale entries require all ten search/confirmation hours manually, or current filters already work; no extra configuration is maintained, giving zero. Partner discussions and first goal writing do not shrink.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop and conduct community health needs surveys

steps.what: Define assessment purpose, population, sampling and permitted information
Choose and write survey questions, response options and analysis categories
Build the questionnaire in the survey system {OTHER}
Pilot the questions and check accessibility and response meaning
Check final survey, information notice, recipient list and release details
Send the exact checked survey invitation to the approved recipient list
Conduct assisted survey interviews and resolve participants' practical questions
First record assisted responses and check the received response data
Tabulate fixed response categories and missing-value counts
Verify count meaning and assess needs with sampling and nonresponse limitations

tasks.design: Configure reusable question controls and fixed response tables in the survey system {OTHER}, with native count exports to {SPREADSHEET}. The specialist selects questions, pilots meaning, checks the exact survey release and retains interviews, first assisted-response capture and interpretation; only the final approved invitation is sent automatically.
tasks.previous_blocker: Question design and respondent support were mixed with repeat form construction and tabulation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native survey controls and deterministic count tables can handle selected categories without deciding community needs.
tasks.still_hard: Selection bias, accessibility and ambiguous responses cannot be solved by automatic counts.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist judges whose needs are missing and whether a response supports a conclusion.
tasks.altitude: Less repeat form construction and counting; assessment design and interpretation remain human.

evidence.claim: Native survey forms and deterministic category counts are plausible components; the time allocation is model knowledge, not a measured survey case.

assumptions: Boundary is an actual mixed-mode needs assessment with questionnaire development, invitation, assisted collection and interpretation. Respondents' own completion time is outside the focal-role baseline and is not claimed as saved.

The specialist first writes question ID, text, response options, missing code and branch conditions in s2. Program administration supplies the existing approved participant list and notice; the specialist checks permitted release in s5. Missing list or notice details require manual preparation within retained s1/s5 rather than a free cleaned feed.

The specialist captures assisted responses in s8 without reduction; direct respondents supply their own responses. Failed exports, ambiguous coding and source errors are repaired within retained s8/s10, with additional failure upkeep below. No model imputes responses or infers individual health conditions.

Three of ten build hours are repeat control and option setup; seven remain for custom questions, branching repairs and checks. Five tabulation hours are existing manual fixed-category counting, not current software runtime. All interpretation remains, including first written conclusions in s10; ordinary saves stay inside retained work without gates or savings.

Test native forms and exports first. The final s5 release binds questionnaire, notice, link and recipients; changes invalidate the real invitation send. No unperformed assessment-report distribution is added.
unknowns: Current form builder and export support
research_questions: Can native controls represent all branch conditions without changing question meaning?
Do missing-value codes remain consistent in the count export?

already_counted.description: Check response quality, count meaning and assessment limitations

incremental.description: Maintain survey templates and count mappings and handle export exceptions

approvals.approved_version: s5 exact tested questionnaire, participant notice, invitation wording, link and named approved recipient list; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central gross is three form-build hours plus one actual invitation send plus five count hours, less 1.5 upkeep = 7.5. Cautious case: bespoke branching needs all ten form-build hours manually; the actual invitation and verified fixed-category counting still remove six hours, less 1.5 upkeep = 4.5. Interviews and first response capture remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read current program delivery status, objectives and staff-reported issues
Supervise, coach and resolve implementation problems with professional and technical staff
Choose responsibilities and corrective actions within program authority
Write actual staff assignments and follow-up dates in the program board
Check final assignment meaning, owners, dates and notification recipients
Send the exact checked assignments to their named staff owners

tasks.design: Configure an existing program-status view in {PROJECT} and an explicit assignment notification through {EMAIL}. Keep all coaching, choices, first assignment writing and final meaning checks with the supervisor; native status retrieval does not score staff or decide allocations.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding existing delivery updates and sending assignments can distract from actual supervision.
tasks.enabler_now: Native board views and version-bound notifications can address those two small transport steps.
tasks.still_hard: Workload, capability and community-service constraints need discussion and judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The supervisor understands staff concerns and takes responsibility for fair, workable assignments.
tasks.altitude: Less navigation and a real notification send; staff-management authority and conversation time stay unchanged.

reach.learn: Service constraints and clear action ownership

evidence.claim: Native project views and explicit assignment notifications can reduce navigation and transport without automating supervision; timings and feasibility are model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual existing staff assignments read and acted upon by staff, not a new meeting log. Staff update program status today; no new reporting burden is silently transferred to them.

Existing updates contain activity ID, owner, due date, delivery state and issue text produced by staff in the current program workflow. The specialist reads and verifies them in s1; missing updates are sought manually in the retained twelve hours. New assignments are first written fully in s4, not supplied by a free structured feed.

Only three of fifteen status hours are searching and switching views; twelve remain for interpretation and clarification. All assignment writing and five final check hours remain. Test native views before code.

The one-hour action is a real notification to staff, not saving the author's board entry. Ordinary saving stays inside unchanged s4 without a gate or saving. The final check binds the exact instruction, owner, due date and recipient; any change voids release permission.
unknowns: Whether existing status updates are complete enough
Current board navigation and notification settings
research_questions: Does the current program board already remove navigation and send checked assignments?

already_counted.description: Check final assignment meaning and notification recipients

incremental.description: Maintain status view and assignment-notification mappings

approvals.approved_version: s5 exact final task instructions, owners, due dates, version identifiers and named staff notification recipients; changes void permission

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central gross is three navigation hours plus one actual notification hour, less 0.5 upkeep = 3.5. Cautious case: informal or incomplete updates need all fifteen status hours manually; the actual approved notification still removes one, less 0.5 upkeep = 0.5. Supervision, decisions and first assignment writing receive no cut.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Community engagement, health judgement, survey interpretation and staff supervision remain human. Specific source lookup, form assembly, counting and actual notifications can shrink where the current workflow supports them.
reach: Work with community health workers on accessible information and reliable needs evidence
skills_to_grow: Check survey response meaning and sampling limitations
Validate final assignment and survey recipients
role.ambitious_version: A health educator with clearer program materials and less repeated data handling while keeping community judgement and direct relationships central.
